name: Create an External Team
description: Create an External Team Link a team from an external provider to a Sentry team. POST /api/0/teams/{organization_id_or_slug}/{team_id_or_slug}/external-teams/
context:
POST /api/0/teams/{organization_id_or_slug}/{team_id_or_slug}/external-teams/
Link a team from an external provider to a Sentry team.
Required: organization_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.; team_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the team the resource belongs to.; body (body)

name: Create a New Project
description: Create a New Project Create a new project bound to a team. POST /api/0/teams/{organization_id_or_slug}/{team_id_or_slug}/projects/
context:
POST /api/0/teams/{organization_id_or_slug}/{team_id_or_slug}/projects/
Create a new project bound to a team. Note: If your organization has disabled member project creation, the `org:write` scope or the Team Admin role on the team is required.
Required: organization_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.; team_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the team the resource belongs to.; body (body)

name: Delete a Team
description: Delete a Team Schedules a team for deletion. DELETE /api/0/teams/{organization_id_or_slug}/{team_id_or_slug}/
context:
DELETE /api/0/teams/{organization_id_or_slug}/{team_id_or_slug}/
Schedules a team for deletion. **Note:** Deletion happens asynchronously and therefore is not immediate. Teams will have their slug released while waiting for deletion.
Required: organization_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.; team_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the team the resource belongs to.

name: Delete an External Team
description: Delete an External Team Delete the link between a team from an external provider and a Sentry team. DELETE /api/0/teams/{organization_id_or_slug}/{team_id_or_slug}/external-teams/{external_team_id}/
context:
DELETE /api/0/teams/{organization_id_or_slug}/{team_id_or_slug}/external-teams/{external_team_id}/
Delete the link between a team from an external provider and a Sentry team.
Required: organization_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.; team_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the team the resource belongs to.; external_team_id (path) — The ID of the external team object. This is returned when creating an external team.

name: Retrieve a Team
description: Retrieve a Team Return details on an individual team. GET /api/0/teams/{organization_id_or_slug}/{team_id_or_slug}/
context:
GET /api/0/teams/{organization_id_or_slug}/{team_id_or_slug}/
Return details on an individual team.
Required: organization_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.; team_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the team the resource belongs to.
Optional: expand (query) — List of strings to opt in to additional data. Supports `projects`, `externalTeams`.; collapse (query) — List of strings to opt out of certain pieces of data. Supports `organization`.

name: List a Team's Members
description: List a Team's Members List all members on a team. GET /api/0/teams/{organization_id_or_slug}/{team_id_or_slug}/members/
context:
GET /api/0/teams/{organization_id_or_slug}/{team_id_or_slug}/members/
List all members on a team. The response will not include members with pending invites.
Required: organization_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.; team_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the team the resource belongs to.
Optional: cursor (query) — A pointer to the last object fetched and its sort order; used to retrieve the next or previous results.

name: List a Team's Projects
description: List a Team's Projects Return a list of projects bound to a team. GET /api/0/teams/{organization_id_or_slug}/{team_id_or_slug}/projects/
context:
GET /api/0/teams/{organization_id_or_slug}/{team_id_or_slug}/projects/
Return a list of projects bound to a team.
Required: organization_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.; team_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the team the resource belongs to.
Optional: cursor (query) — A pointer to the last object fetched and its sort order; used to retrieve the next or previous results.

context:

Required: organization_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.; team_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the team the resource belongs to.; body (body)

context:

Update a team in an external provider that is currently linked to a Sentry team.
Required: organization_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.; team_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the team the resource belongs to.; external_team_id (path) — The ID of the external team object.
